hero.lead: Freelance full stack developer helping startups, independents and small businesses ship with Next.js, React, NestJS and TypeScript, now specialising in systems, networks and cybersecurity.

about.description:
My training at 42 in Bangkok gave me solid technical foundations, real discipline and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. I’m starting a bachelor’s in Systems, Networks & Cybersecurity Administration at MyDigitalSchool Angers, which also lets me handle deployment, infrastructure and security (Linux, Docker, Nginx). Two years spent in Cambodia taught me to adapt quickly and collaborate in diverse environments.

Alongside client work, I build my own products, like Whoa UI, a React component library, or Whoa Stash, a macOS app: useful tools, built to last.
